beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:bd.title: Tax Manager
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:bd.description: ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE Beacon Software https://beaconsoftware.com/ is a permanent capital holding company which acquires and grows essential businesses. We are a profitable series B+ firm that combines great technologists, operators and M&A professionals to accelerate the scale of the ambition of the dozens of businesses we own and operate. We are supported by capital from tier-1 venture capital, crossover, and endowment investors as well as the founders of the leading technology companies from the past decade. ROLE AND MISSION Beacon is seeking a Tax Manager to own the tax function across our portfolio of software businesses in Canada and the United States. This role is responsible for compliance, provision, indirect tax, and transaction tax across a growing, multi-entity, acquisition-driven group. This is a senior, self-directed role. You will own the technical tax agenda and lead our external tax advisors and specialists rather than depend on internal coaching. You will also help lead the tax workstream of our ongoing ASPE → IFRS conversion. This is a foundational role in building an internal tax capability that scales with our growth. Location: Toronto, ON Working Arrangements: Hybrid (In-office 3–4 days / week) WHAT YOU'LL DO TAX COMPLIANCE — CANADA & U.S. - Own Canadian corporate income tax (T2) compliance across all entities, including installments, elections, and supporting schedules. - Own U.S. federal and state corporate income tax compliance across operating entities. - Maintain a portfolio-wide compliance calendar and ensure timely, accurate filings across all jurisdictions. - Coordinate cross-border matters (e.g., Canada–U.S. structures, withholding, intercompany) with internal finance and external advisors. INDIRECT TAX & STATE REGISTRATIONS - Own sales tax, GST/HST, and U.S. state/local indirect tax compliance across the portfolio. - Lead multi-state nexus analysis and complete new state registrations — a common gap as we acquire and integrate U.S. companies. - Manage indirect tax setup, registrations, and account configuration for newly acquired entities. TAX PROVISION, IFRS & CONSOLIDATION - Prepare and review current and deferred tax provisions to support consolidated financial reporting. - Lead the tax workstream of the ASPE→IFRS conversion, including deferred tax under IAS 12. - Support the year-end audit on all tax matters and act as the primary point of contact with auditors on tax. M&A / TRANSACTION TAX - Support deal structuring, including entity structure and cross-border (Canada/U.S.) considerations. - Review purchase agreements for tax provisions and support post-close tax true-ups and integration. - Onboard acquired entities into the tax compliance calendar, provision process, and control environment. ADVISOR & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP - Own and lead relationships with our external tax advisors (Canadian and U.S.) — directing the work, not simply liaising. - Partner with Corporate Finance to align tax data flows and reporting. - Work alongside the Director of Finance on tax planning, structuring, and process automation, and support ad hoc analyses. QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA designation required. - Tax specialization — CPA In-Depth Tax (Canada) or U.S. CPA / EA equivalent. - 6+ years of progressive tax experience, ideally with Big 4 or a national accounting firm. - Hands-on experience with cross-border Canada/U.S. corporate income tax compliance. - Experience preparing and reviewing tax provisions and deferred tax (ASPE, IFRS/IAS 12, or U.S. GAAP). - Self-directed and technically authoritative — able to own the function and lead external advisors independently, without internal coaching on technical tax matters. - Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with high attention to detail. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Indirect tax experience (GST/HST, U.S. sales/use) and U.S. multi-state registration / nexus. - M&A / transaction tax experience,

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:3571d731-b69.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. We're hiring a Digital & Field Events Marketer to: - Own all things events for the Company ranging from industry events, tradeshows, and conferences to small luncheons and thought leadership conversations - Own all things events related to digital such as webinars and podcasts. including hosting and being the face for the company for these events. This is a hands-on role for someone 2-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Note that this is an individual contributor role, in that you will be the first events hire within the team. If you like creativity and autonomy to try new events, this is the place for you. If you like structure and being told what to do, this is unfortunately not the right company for you. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Sweden. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. jobgether-jobgether:lever:871973be-f044-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Governance Analyst based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to shape enterprise data governance within a large-scale modernization program supporting federal court operations across the United States. You will help establish the policies, standards, processes, and accountability models that ensure data is managed as a strategic asset. Working across business, technology, security, privacy, legal, and records-management teams, you will turn governance requirements into practical controls and processes. The position combines data standards architecture, data quality, metadata, stewardship, privacy, and compliance. You will also contribute to governance roadmaps, maturity assessments, training, and continuous improvement. This is a fully remote role with no expected travel and an environment focused on modern data platforms, analytics, and responsible use of AI/ML. Support the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of enterprise data governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and operating models. Define and maintain data standards, naming conventions, business definitions, data structures, reference data, and governance requirements across multiple systems and delivery teams. Establish data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models, including RACI frameworks and stewardship responsibilities. Partner with business stakeholders, Data Owners and Stewards, security, privacy, legal, records management, engineering, and technology teams to operationalize governance requirements. Ensure data assets are appropriately classified and managed according to sensitivity, criticality, business value, privacy, security, retention, and regulatory requirements. Translate policies and regulatory requirements into actionable governance controls, procedures, and compliant data-sharing practices. Identify data governance gaps, risks, and compliance issues, coordinate remediation activities, and monitor the adoption and effectiveness of governance standards. Support data access, sharing, usage, and lifecycle governance processes while contributing to governance councils, working groups, and data-domain forums. Develop governance documentation, standards, decision logs, procedures, training materials, and awareness programs for technical and business audiences. Support governance assessments, audits, compliance reviews, maturity evaluations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Track, analyze, and report governance metrics, maturity, and compliance status to leadership and governance councils. Contribute to data governance roadmaps and help foster a consistent, data-driven culture across geographically distributed business and technical teams. Requirements Master’s degree in a relevant field with 5+ years of general information-systems experience and 7+ years of specialized experience, or comparable experience and qualifications. Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise data governance programs and translating governance policies into practical operational processes. Strong understanding of data quality management, metadata management, data stewardship, ownership models, and enterprise data standards. Experience governing high-sensitivity, regulated, or compliance-focused data environments. Experience with data-quality profiling and monitoring techniques, as well as modern data governance tooling and operating practices. Strong knowledge of data modeling, integration patterns, and change data capture concepts. Experience with metadata and data catalog platforms such as Collibra, Alation, or Qlik, with practical exposure to business glossaries and data lineage.
